materialBudget.scope: Independent hypothetical campaigns; indexed finite grants and chronological source witnesses; no claim of exhaustive loot or actual campaign supply.

admission.scope: Selected active victory research and fixed final soldier body, with cap growth restored after each repeat. Other bodies, clone offspring and item conversion are separate objectives; excluded research follows the explicit branch model or a current v.o2 replay-bound irreversible research proof. Exact same-body repeat fixed points use replay and conditional ordinary supplies only. A single Shade reset action can also be discharged by a source-bound per-stat dominance proof with invariant non-stat state. Tiger Tours may be discharged by an exact fixed-body repeat/cycle with its declared economic reward separately retained. Material checks use the source-bound v.o2 supply index. Economic and calendar optimization are not certified. Unknown actions fail open. No proof of return cycles, global optimum, actual gameplay or campaign-wide impossibility.
